technical.summary: COST shows strong structural bullish alignment across moving averages and trend indicators with moderate ADX, but short-term overbought conditions (RSI-9, Stoch-K) and weak volume confirmation (OBV not rising) limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent; earnings in 59 days presents timing risk with minimal conviction indicators.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 small purchases by junior members), neutral market fear/greed, and unavailable news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (286.4) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 59-day earnings window adds moderate event risk to already hostile volatility environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong structural bullish alignment (price above all major MAs, supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, ADX trending) provides solid directional framework for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis regime (286.4), short-term overbought conditions (RSI-9 76.61, Stoch-K 85.08), weak volume confirmation (OBV not rising), and high earnings risk in 59 days create hostile entry environment with limited margin of safety.
